task: Propagate chat Stop action to abort the underlying workflow execution when a workflow is started from chat (EPMCDME-11735).

key_reasoning.reason: Conversation abort router, WorkflowExecutionService.abort and possibly the stream disconnect handler in routers/utils.py; the runtime already honors ABORTED via DB polling.
Which endpoint the chat Stop button calls and how conversation_id maps to execution_id is unverified; ABORTED vs FAILED interplay is open. Two to three design questions remain.

Reuses existing abort machinery (no novel pattern), but cancellation is cooperative only, ABORTED may be overwritten by FAILED, and GenerationManager is per-pod. The AC list start/stop/completed cases, but the existing abort tests are a usable template.
